laws.label: Change income tax
laws.description: Sets the tax taken from wages paid in regions this country controls.

laws.label: Change market tax
laws.description: Sets the tax taken from market sales made in this country.

laws.label: Change self-work tax
laws.description: Sets the tax rate recorded for self-work.

laws.label: Change production tax
laws.description: Share of everything companies in this country produce that goes to the treasury as goods. Fractions carry over, so one unit is taken once the share adds up to a whole unit.

laws.label: Declare war
laws.description: Opens a state of war, which permits attacks on the target's regions.

laws.label: Propose peace
laws.description: Offers peace. The other government must accept; a non-aggression window follows.

laws.label: Declare rival
laws.description: Citizens deal bonus damage against the sworn enemy. Has daily upkeep.

laws.label: Defensive pact
laws.description: Offers a mutual defence pact. Requires acceptance by the other government.

laws.label: End defensive pact
laws.description: Withdraws from an existing pact.

laws.label: Non-aggression pact
laws.description: Offers a promise that neither country declares war on the other. Requires acceptance by the other government.

laws.label: End non-aggression pact
laws.description: Ends a non-aggression pact after a 24-hour notice.

laws.label: Found alliance
laws.description: Creates a multilateral alliance led by this country. Has daily upkeep.

laws.label: Request to join alliance
laws.description: Applies to an alliance; its members vote on admission.

laws.label: Accept alliance invitation
laws.description: Joins the alliance that invited this country. The alliance already voted, so the country joins as soon as this passes.

laws.label: Withdraw alliance request
laws.description: Takes back this country's pending request to join an alliance and ends the admission vote.

laws.label: Leave alliance
laws.description: Leaves the current alliance. A rejoin cooldown applies.

laws.label: Set map colour
laws.description: Changes the country's colour on the map.

laws.label: Send treasury funds
laws.description: Transfers money from the treasury to another country. A paper fee applies by relationship.

laws.label: Transfer region
laws.description: Cedes a controlled region to another country.

laws.label: Set specialization
laws.description: Chooses the resource this country's companies produce with a bonus.

laws.label: Set citizenship fee
laws.description: Gold a player pays to become a citizen (0 to 1,000). It is held while the application waits and paid to the treasury when accepted; refunded if rejected or cancelled.

laws.label: Set immigration pitch
laws.description: A short message shown for this country on the immigration board, to invite new citizens.

laws.label: Set Discord server
laws.description: Sets the country's Discord invite shown on the country page. Leave the link empty to remove it.

laws.label: Change import tax
laws.description: Tax this country's buyers pay on global-market purchases from abroad.

laws.label: Change export tax
laws.description: Tax this country's sellers pay on global-market sales to buyers abroad.

laws.label: Embargo a country
laws.description: Blocks global-market trade with the target in both directions for 7 days.

laws.label: Lift embargo
laws.description: Ends an embargo this country imposed.

laws.label: Impeach president
laws.description: Removes the president; the vice president takes office. Only congress votes.

laws.label: Admit country
laws.description: Admits an applicant country.

laws.label: Invite country
laws.description: Invites a country to join. Its government then accepts with a law; no second alliance vote is needed.

laws.label: Expel member
laws.description: Removes a member country.

laws.label: Change leader
laws.description: Transfers alliance leadership.

laws.label: Set alliance colour
laws.description: Changes the colour used by the alliance map layer.

laws.label: Disband alliance
laws.description: Dissolves the alliance.
